hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qP '(^|[|;&(]|\s)(cat|head|tail|less|more|sed|awk|nl|tac|od|xxd|strings|base64|cp|mv|rsync|scp|tar|dd|source|grep|rg|ugrep|egrep|fgrep|jq|python|python3|perl|ruby|node|bat|vi|vim|nano|emacs|cut|sort|uniq|split|cmp|diff|md5sum|sha256sum)\s+[^|;&]*?(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])\.env(?!\.(default|example|sample|template))(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Project rule: agents never read a live .env - it holds real credentials. Read .env.default instead (placeholders). Deferred rotation context: bd tj-10jczr."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qP '(^|[|;&(]|\s)git(\s+-[Cc]\s+\S+|\s+--?[A-Za-z][\w-]*(=\S+)?)*\s+push(\s|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Project rule: no agent pushes, in any spelling. The user pushes by hand."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { c=$(cat); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qP '(^|[|;&(]|\s)bd(\s+-\S+)*\s+(init|dolt\s+set\s+host)(\s|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qP '(^|\s)BEADS_DIR=(\s|$)|unset\s+BEADS_DIR|env\s+-u\s+BEADS_DIR' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Project rule: BEADS_DIR points every bd at the real task store, so bd init and bd dolt set host would rewrite its tracked config. In a scratch repo, write BEADS_DIR= in the same command first (for example BEADS_DIR= bd init ...). If the command only appears as prose, for example in a commit message or note, reword it so the literal command is not in the text."}}' || true; }
